sentences.en: He lived detached from all the troubles of our family.
sentences.zh: 他与我们家的所有烦恼保持着距离。

sentences.en: My aunt lives in a detached house in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 我姑妈住在乡下的独立屋。

sentences.en: Mick, let me see your blueprint for the Nelsons' detached house.
sentences.zh: 迈克，把给内尔森家设计的独立屋蓝图给我看看。
